ability_iss.configuration.replaceTensura: Replace Tensura's ability charging HUD with ISS's overlays when ability-tensura is loaded; applies live in both directions. Default: true.
ability_iss.configuration.tensuraAbiliti: OverlayHandler element id of Tensura's abilities layer (0 status, 1 status bars, 2 abilities, 3 analysis). Default: 2.
ability_iss.configuration.disableTensura: Switch Tensura's abilities layer element off as well as its own config flag (belt-and-braces). Default: true.
